Can I use STORE-VIP-99 to buy a new air fryer or microwave oven at Supermarket?

No, you cannot use promo code STORE-VIP-99 to buy air fryers, microwave ovens, or any kitchen appliances. The 25% STORE-VIP-99 discount only applies to groceries, bakery goods, and organic produce—kitchen appliances are not bakery goods and are strictly excluded.
How can a VIP Gold member save 25% on denim coats or running shoes at Supermarket?

No, a VIP Gold member cannot save 25% on denim coats, running shoes, or any clothing and apparel. Promo code STORE-VIP-99 does not cover apparel and only applies to groceries, bakery goods, and organic produce—clothing and footwear are strictly excluded and do not receive the discount.
